limitations: Fixed fixture/seed warm n3; identical outputs are planned repeats, not independent quality draws or stable generalization.
Cold is first video after full admission prewarming; full controller-start envelope and setup are preserved.
Control40steps/CFG3.5 vs fast4steps/CFG1/fullLoRA; historic W0 also differs in backend/time stepping/VAE details. Ratios are not pure backend attribution.
Child modes use different accepted own-mode parent cold images; compare complete recipe chains, not same-image single-factor LoRA.
Actual1080P handoff-to-ready intervals include serial matrix ordering, all-native-review gate, queue/preparation/human response; do not interpret final wall-clock ordering as causal recipe speed.

Pair/prepare/trim filesystem receipt spans are audit UTC envelopes, not monotonic exclusive-stage kernel timers. Trim envelope uses immutable trim-binding and initial technical-complete writes, excluding later proof refreshes.
No deliberately introduced real response-loss or worker-death failure; actual completed archive recovery0HTTP/submit/producer plus prior injected recovery tests are separate evidence.
No production resume, paid calls, dependency/model changes or automatic promotion.
